name: Astrum
source:
Faction: Angel
Race: Seraph
Occupation: Knight
Reality: University medical student
Hobby: Watching westerns alone
Specialty: Remembering things
Favorite Food: Tortillas
Dislikes: Fortune-telling 

"Come with me, Amadeus. No scar shall grace this hand."

The arrogant leader of the Angels, who has unshaken confidence and pride in himself. Trusted by those around him and praised at all times, he has been elevated to godly status in the eyes of his followers.

In order to make Kazuha his, he is very persistent in his approach to her without any regard to those around them. In real life, he attends a prestigious medical school to carry out his father’s plans for him to become a doctor. His focus is purely academic, and as he’s not very sociable, he’s often called “invisible” by his peers.

Annoyed by those who don’t acknowledge or respect him, he is frustrated with how different things are in real life versus his life in Arcadia. 

[From the [url=http://aksysgames.com/pcube/]official site[/url]]
